description: This is a Java test class for the ExternalAssetOwnerTransferOutstandingInterestCalculation component, containing unit tests that verify its behavior under different loan state scenarios.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferOutstandingInterestCalculationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ExternalAssetOwnerTransferOutstandingInterestCalculation, testing calculation of outstanding interest based on loan state and configuration.

methods.name: testCalculateOutstandingInterest_WhenLoanNotDisbursed_ShouldReturnZero
